PLAN "4-Week Postpartum On-Ramp: Home + Light Dumbbells"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Restore safe movement foundation and gradual strength baseline post partum"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Acclimatisation Session 1":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 30 seconds
          hip_flexor_stretch 30 seconds
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Acclimatisation Session 2":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 2 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          one_arm_row 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 30 seconds
          hamstring_stretch 30 seconds
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Friday training 40m "Acclimatisation Session 3":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_press 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          split_squat 3x8..10 per leg rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x20 seconds rpe 5
        cooldown:
          thoracic_rotations 30 seconds
  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Progression Week 1":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 3x9..11 rpe 6.5 rest 60 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x11..13 rpe 6.5 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x9..11 rpe 6.5 rest 60 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x11..13 rpe 6.5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_stretch 30 seconds
          chest_stretch 30 seconds
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Progression Week 1 Cont'd":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x9..11 rpe 6.5 rest 60 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x11..13 rpe 6.5 rest 60 seconds
          one_arm_row 3x9..11 rpe 6.5 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12..15 rpe 6.5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 30 seconds
          hip_flexor_stretch 30 seconds
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Friday training 45m "Progression Week 1 Cont'd":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_press 3x9..11 rpe 6.5 rest 60 seconds
          split_squat 3x9..11 per leg rpe 6.5 rest 60 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x9..11 rpe 6.5 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x25 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 30 seconds
          back_stretch 30 seconds
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Progression Week 2":
        warmup:
          walking 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 3x10..12 rpe 6.5 rest 60 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x12..14 rpe 6.5 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x10..12 rpe 6.5 rest 60 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x12..14 rpe 6.5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          thigh_calf_stretches 60 seconds
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Progression Week 2 Cont'd":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x10..12 rpe 6.5 rest 60 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x12..14 rpe 6.5 rest 60 seconds
          one_arm_row 3x10..12 rpe 6.5 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x14..16 rpe 6.5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 30 seconds
          hip_flexor_stretch 30 seconds
      DAY Friday training 50m "Progression Week 2 Cont'd":
        warmup:
          walking 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_press 3x10..12 rpe 6.5 rest 60 seconds
          split_squat 3x10..12 per leg rpe 6.5 rest 60 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10..12 rpe 6.5 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x30 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 30 seconds
          back_stretch 30 seconds
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Stabilization & Foundation Reset":
        warmup:
          walking 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 3x10..12 rpe 6.5 rest 60 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x12..14 rpe 6.5 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x10..12 rpe 6.5 rest 60 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x12..14 rpe 6.5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 30 seconds
          chest_stretch 30 seconds
      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Stabilization & Foundation Reset Cont'd":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x10..12 rpe 6.5 rest 60 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x12..14 rpe 6.5 rest 60 seconds
          one_arm_row 3x10..12 rpe 6.5 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x14..16 rpe 6.5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 30 seconds
          hip_flexor_stretch 30 seconds
      DAY Friday training 55m "Mobility & Light Conditioning":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_press 3x10..12 rpe 6.5 rest 60 seconds
          split_squat 3x10..12 per leg rpe 6.5 rest 60 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10..12 rpe 6.5 rest 60 seconds
          hollow_hold 3x20 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 30 seconds
          quad_stretch 30 seconds

SYNTAX RULES:
- Rep ranges use TWO dots, not a dash. Correct: `3x8..12`. Wrong: `3x8-12` or `3x8-10`.
- Sets always come first: `3x10` means 3 sets of 10 reps.
- RPE goes after sets/reps: `3x8..12 rpe 7`.
- Rest in seconds: `rest 90 seconds`.
